explanation: An unknown gift of speech often interpreted as a foreign or spiritual language, mentioned in the chapter as something that must be interpreted to build up the church.
The speaking where one conveys God's message in an understandable language to people with the purpose of comforting, encouraging, and strengthening faith.
The principle that everything in worship should take place in a tidy and well-ordered manner to avoid chaos and misunderstandings.
The act where a person translates or explains the content of a tongue so that the entire church can understand it.
The concept describing the goal of all spiritual gifts, namely to strengthen faith and community in the church through clear communication.
